title: KW T950 FUPS Bullbar Custom Built Road Train Bullbar #18
description: Kenworth T950 Custom Built high tensile fully polished aluminium FUPS Road Train Bullbar. 88mm one piece main cross pipes passing through drilled uprights for maximum strength, no butt welds. 100mm box uprights shown with 160mm distance from the grille to the front of the uprights and custom designed heavy duty main channel with provision for front mudflaps. Reversible aluminium road train signs. Extra deep main channel. Heavy duty backing plate with 35mm tow pin. Driving light mounts fitted to customer requirements. Heavy duty spring assist to raise lowered bull bar. Bull bar can be custom built to your requirements.
